items.exampleEn: Fishing vessels go out to sea every night.
The boat has a small electric motor.
items.exampleZh: 這艘船有一具小型電動馬達。

items.exampleEn: The arrival hall was full of people waiting for friends.
items.exampleZh: 入境大廳擠滿了等朋友的人。

items.exampleEn: Rail tickets are cheaper if you buy them early.
items.exampleZh: 火車票提早買比較便宜。

items.exampleEn: The railroad goes through three small towns.
items.exampleZh: 這條鐵路穿過三個小鎮。

items.exampleEn: The exploration of the cave took three days.
items.exampleZh: 探索那個洞穴花了三天。

items.exampleEn: The horses pulled a wagon full of apples.
items.exampleZh: 馬拉著一輛裝滿蘋果的四輪貨車。

items.exampleEn: The cost of transport has gone up this year.
items.exampleZh: 今年的運輸費用上漲了。

items.sentenceEn: The arrival time of our train is 6:40.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的火車抵達時間是 6:40。

items.audioEn: The motor on our boat stopped working, so we had to wait for help.
items.audioZh: 我們船上的馬達故障了，所以只好等人來幫忙。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼得等人幫忙？

items.sentenceEn: Traveling by rail is more relaxing than driving.
items.sentenceZh: 搭火車旅行比開車輕鬆。

items.sentenceEn: The museum has an old wagon from the farm.
items.sentenceZh: 博物館裡有一輛來自農場的舊貨車。

items.stemEn: A large ____ carrying oil arrived at the port this morning.
items.stemZh: 一艘載著石油的大船今天早上抵達港口。

items.stemEn: Horses were the main form of ____ in the past.
items.stemZh: 過去馬是主要的交通工具。

items.passageEn: Before the railroad came to the valley, farmers used horses and wagons for the transport of their goods. The trip to the port took four days. More than a hundred years ago, workers built a rail line through the valley, and the arrival of the first train was a big event. Today, the old station is a museum. It shows how the railroad made the exploration of the region easier and brought new people to the area.
items.passageZh: 鐵路通到山谷以前，農民用馬和貨車運送貨物，到港口要走四天。一百多年前，工人在山谷中鋪了一條鐵路線，第一班火車抵達時是件大事。如今，舊車站成了博物館，展示鐵路如何讓探索這個地區變得更容易，並帶來新的居民。

questions.questionZh: 鐵路通車以前，到港口要多久？

items.promptZh: 我比較喜歡搭火車旅行。
referenceEn: I prefer to travel by rail.
rubricZh: rail 表示「鐵路」，by rail＝搭火車
「比較喜歡」可寫，例如 prefer to…、prefer …ing 等
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.instructionZh: 用 exploration 造一個句子，說說你對探險或太空探索的看法。
referenceEn: I think space exploration is exciting.
The exploration of the deep sea interests me a lot.
rubricZh: 可用 space exploration、the exploration of… 等說法
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
